admin_operations_target_coherent.name: admin_operations_target_coherent
admin_operations_target_coherent.value: (target_kind = 'platform' and target_workspace_id is null) or (target_kind = 'workspace' and target_workspace_id is not null)

workspace_audit_logs_status_allowed.name: workspace_audit_logs_status_allowed
workspace_audit_logs_status_allowed.value: (from_status is null or from_status in ('active', 'suspended', 'deactivated')) and (to_status is null or to_status in ('active', 'suspended', 'deactivated'))

workspace_audit_logs_credit_fields_coher.name: workspace_audit_logs_credit_fields_coherent
workspace_audit_logs_credit_fields_coher.value: (action = 'wallet_adjust' and from_status is null and to_status is null and credit_amount > 0 and btrim(credit_reason) <> '' and credit_transaction_id is not null) or (action <> 'wallet_adjust' and credit_amount is null and credit_reason is null and credit_transaction_id is null)

credit_holds_amounts_conserved.name: credit_holds_amounts_conserved
credit_holds_amounts_conserved.value: captured_amount >= 0 and released_amount >= 0 and captured_amount + released_amount <= original_amount

credit_holds_status_coherent.name: credit_holds_status_coherent
credit_holds_status_coherent.value: (status = 'active' and captured_amount + released_amount < original_amount and close_transaction_id is null and closed_at is null) or (status = 'closed' and captured_amount + released_amount = original_amount and close_transaction_id is not null and closed_at is not null)

ledger_entries_wallet_coherent.name: ledger_entries_wallet_coherent
ledger_entries_wallet_coherent.value: (bucket = 'platform_clearing' and wallet_id is null) or (bucket in ('available', 'held') and wallet_id is not null)

billing_orders_actual_range.name: billing_orders_actual_range
billing_orders_actual_range.value: actual_amount is null or (actual_amount >= 0 and actual_amount <= estimated_amount)

billing_orders_status_amount_coherent.name: billing_orders_status_amount_coherent
billing_orders_status_amount_coherent.value: (status in ('reserved', 'review') and actual_amount is null) or (status = 'settled' and actual_amount is not null) or (status = 'released' and actual_amount = 0)

assets_state_coherent.name: assets_state_coherent
assets_state_coherent.value: (status = 'staging' and media_type is null and byte_size is null and sha256 is null and failure_reason is null and deleted_at is null) or (status = 'ready' and media_type is not null and byte_size is not null and sha256 is not null and failure_reason is null and deleted_at is null) or (status = 'failed' and failure_reason is not null and deleted_at is null) or (status = 'deleted' and deleted_at is not null)
